$comment: RFC 8785 JCS canonical envelope. Canonical live writes are hash-chained and sequenced per project_id via prev_digest. Nullable lineage fields remain only for compatibility readers of historical rows; the production LedgerEmitter supplies project_id, principal_id, harness_digest, causation/correlation defaults, and the applicable episode lineage. SPEC §1.2.
title: EventEnvelopeV2

project_id.$comment: ADR-0074 §5 consistency unit. Nullable only for compatibility reads; canonical live writers require a non-empty value.

harness_digest.$comment: D_H of the composition under which this event was produced (ADR-0071).

authority_source.description: Writer role whose authority admitted this event. Never inferred from the payload.

policy_version.description: Policy version in force at append.

approval_reference.description: Human approval this event rests on; null only when semantically inapplicable.

capability_grant.description: Capability grant this event rests on; null only when semantically inapplicable.

description: mhf.event/2 -- the mhf.event/1 envelope plus four typed authority-provenance fields (ADR-0098 Decision 1). /1 remains readable and unchanged.
